A '''Form 98BG-H''' was a form in the bureaucracy of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that could be filed if emergency evacuation protocols were not followed properly. A [[Form 98BG-HM7]] was a specialized version of the form for ground-forces invasions.
